    The universal cover of P inside that of a Galois cover #

    The projection of the Galois cover induces piBar : FG(GCover V) ⥤ FG(P). Lifting walk classes from the base point (x₀, 1) (the action gAct) gives a map coverMap from the universal cover of P to that of GCover V, with left inverse coverProj (coverProj_map), sending arrows to arrows (exists_path_map). Hence cycle-freeness and interval-finiteness pass from the universal cover of the Galois cover to that of P (cycleFree_of_gcover, intervalFinite_of_gcover).
